releases.name: v1.4.2 - npm release
releases.body:
Includes `NOTICE` in the published npm package so upstream attribution ships with
the bundle (MIT compliance). First `npm` release of this plugin.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-browser-agent

releases.name: v1.4.1 - license detection + CI
releases.body:
Standardizes the MIT license and adds project hygiene.

### Changed

- `LICENSE` is now the unmodified, standard MIT text so GitHub detects the
  license (previously reported as `NOASSERTION`). Upstream attribution for
  `opencode-agent-browser` moved to a new `NOTICE` file.

### Added

- GitHub Actions CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): typecheck, build, and unit
  tests on Ubuntu and Windows — plus a CI badge in the README.
- Issue templates and a "Why this plugin?" / "Demo" section in the README.
